notes.title: 1.0.5.881 is out!! Some bug fixes and improvements
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136733/667e3e9a0d0fbb79989ee32b471628b1b112797a.png

Feature fixed and improved : We have improved and fixed a feature that was previously present but was working incorrectly in all effects (Pixelation, dithering, LCD screen effects) containing a color palette. Thus, if you choose any image other than 256x1 png files, which are the standard PixageFX color palette, PixageFX will automatically add the colors of the image you selected to your palette.

Fix for Neural Style Transfer effect: Previously, some images were screwed. We fixed this bug.

notes.title: Version 1.0.4.8 is OUT!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136733/d39f68b554660439b19e1f500dc092d46e6f7ac0.png

What's new in 1.0.4.8


- New effect added : Normal Map Generator 

Unlike normal map generators in the market, Pixel Art Workshop finds the contours of the image and creates a normal map according to the contours. Thus, you can get normal maps with much more organic and depth when desired.
It also has a separate normal map mode for images with alpha channels.

- New effect added : Alpha Glow

Creates a glow based on the alpha channel.

- Some interface improvements : We've added parameter groupings for effects with too many parameters. Thus, the effects have a more understandable interface.

notes.title: Version 1.0.4.7 is OUT!!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136733/bf80d075714bae7c59ae5f78699a2bcc9a421dc7.png

In this version some minor bugs have been fixed and also a new effect has been added.

FACE DEFORMER EFFECT

With the 'Face Deform' effect, Pixel Art Workshop can detect and deform human faces in photos, giving them a new unrealistic shape. Currently, it can detect only one frontal-view face in the image.
After detection, you can deform eyebrows, eyes, chin, face, nose and lips.

notes.title: Version 1.0.4.6 is out!!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136733/5b4728561d9c53a85a627f55087cf3d7cf4f317c.png

In this version, we have made changes in two effects. 

* The Crop effect which previously only worked on percentages, now works with both percent and pixel modes. In Pixel mode, you can write exactly the output size you want in pixels.

* We also improved the Resize Canvas (formerly Extend Canvas) effect so that  you can exactly set the outputsize in pixels.

Two new effects (Alpha Threshold and Color Counter) and a new category (Info) have been added.

* Alpha Threshold: With this effect, you can set an alpha pixel to a fixed value to the lower and upper values of a certain threshold value. For example, you can clear (or set them to zero) all alpha pixels which have values below 255.

* Color Counter: This is a new 'info category' effect that calculates exactly how many unique colors are in your pixel art image. Thus, you will be able to get the number of colors in the image at any stage you want.

notes.title: 1.0.4.4 RELEASE! New LOOKUPTABLE (LUT) Effect
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136733/d42d024fa3304aa2104991e14ec7e3640a37b0e8.png

With new LUT effect, you will now be able to use CUBE extension LookUpTable files.

Unfortunately there are some limitations on this effect.
* Cannot currently process CUBE files above LUT_3D_SIZE 33 (For example cannot process LUT_3D_SIZE 64)
* If there are some unclamped values in the CUBE file, undesirable results may occur.

However, we will improve this effect and remove limitations as well.

notes.title: 1.0.322 Release
notes.notes:
What's new in this version;

The color limit for the 'Palette Quantization' effect has been increased to 256. 
Also, the 'Load Palette' part has changed a bit. 
Thus, you can now create palettes from any image within the color limit. This will allow you to use exported PNG palettes from different applications.
(Only PNG, JPG and GIF images are supported. Palette formats such as JASC PAL are not currently supported.)

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 is ready!
notes.notes:
The most important update in this version is that video import problems such as freezing and skipping are now fixed. Also, video import is now much faster (Use fast mode).
Another added feature is the ability to import animated GIF images, so you can import GIF animations like video files.

Also fixed the inverted edge selection bug.

Known bugs:
- In some long-running processes (such as the Mean Shift effect) the program can go into an infinite loop. The only way to fix this right now is to delete that effect. It will be fixed as soon as possible.
- Unable to save visited folders and main configuration file.(Will be fixed in next version)

New feature:
- GIF Animation import.

Features to be added soon:
- Thresholding and smoothing will be added to Laplace and Highpass effects, thus making these effects more usable.
- Mp4 video export feature will be added.
- Layer feature will be added. Thus, it will be possible to work with more than one source image.
